The two guarded primary board keys and mandatory pre-adoption snapshot then failed even when lossless archive compaction would create room, and a green cloud badge could hide the unsaved local edit.
intendedBehavior: After safe automatic-history retirement is exhausted, compact the recovery index in its existing key and retry the guarded primary save or mandatory adoption backup. Whole-index compaction preserves the exact decoded UTF-16 JSON; appending a required safety row preserves every existing payload byte. Retain physical compare-and-swap semantics, corrupt and unknown formats, and already-compacted irreducible failures. Show a save error until a later durable local save succeeds.

preservedCoverage: Manual, displaced local edits, Restore proofs, account-switch copies, stale-tab copies, other-browser copies, shared recovery IDs, and protected pins remain present with payload bytes unchanged after compaction and reload.
Unreadable or unknown archive formats remain untouched and block overwrite; a pre-codec shell cannot parse the versioned envelope and therefore follows its existing fail-closed save path.
The two primary board keys retain their existing plain JSON, guarded pair-write, rollback, stale-tab, and Restore-safety behavior; only the recovery-index storage boundary is compacted.
An already compacted archive that still cannot fit retains the prior index and both primary keys, while optional automatic history continues to retire under its existing data-safety rules.
Packed raw view and download return the exact decoded JSON, and targeted deletion preserves every other row's lexical bytes before atomically replacing the physical packed index.
The vendored codec and license are local offline shell assets with a pinned byte fingerprint and no runtime network dependency.
